obligations.text: Part II [If following elements cannot be displayed in a prominent way on one page, they shall be displayed in the first part of the form on the second page]:

Other important legal aspects Where applicable The creditor is entitled to compensation in the case of early repayment [Determination of the compensation (calculation method) in accordance with the provisions implementing Article 29 of Directive (EU) 2023/2225 of the European Parliament and of the Council ( 1 ) ] Consultation of a database The creditor must inform you immediately and without charge of the result of consulting a database, if a credit application is rejected on the basis of such a consultation.
